problems: Vitest coverage is broken repo-wide: `vitest run --coverage` with the root vitest.config.ts reports 0 files, even with an --coverage.include override (it is likely the projects root or the space in the path 'Plotinium OS'). I measured with a temporary standalone config instead. Root config is not mine to fix.

Bug fixed in server/src/db/client.ts: pg lets fields parsed from connectionString override the explicit `password` option. DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE was therefore silently ignored, so the containerised server could not have authenticated. The password now goes inside the URL, in memory only.

Anti-DSA violation left by the earlier run, fixed: server/src/ratelimit/store.ts had a hand-written LRU in production code. It is now a KeyStore interface (subset of dsa LRU<K,V>) backed by an insertion-order bounded Map, which is not an LRU. TODO(R1) marks where to switch to dsa/lru LruCache.

DB-05 plan at bench10k: Q2 is planned as Hash Join + Seq Scan on inodes + Sort (1.5 ms). The spec's CI assertion 'Q2 and Q3 plans contain no Sort node' would fail at 10k. At bench100k Q2 is a Nested Loop with no Sort (0.67 ms).

database.md §4.10's kysely-codegen command only excludes schema_migrations. The pg_stat_statements views in public show up as drift, so the exclude pattern must be '(schema_migrations|pg_stat_statements*)'. This is documented in server/src/db/README.md.
